capabilities: Replace typed text fragments with symbols or replacement text while typing
Manage substitution rules in settings with enable, disable, add, remove, search, and swap actions
Create rules from selected text via the Add Substitution command
Write regex rules with /pattern$/flags syntax and capture placeholders like $1
Undo the last substitution by pressing Backspace immediately after it fires
extras: Only triggers on single-character direct typing; pasted or multi-character insertions do not fire substitutions, and invalid regex rules are ignored with a notice on load.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in configurable text expansion for turning typed fragments like --> or != into symbols such as → or ≠ while typing.
summary: Text-substitution plugin that replaces typed fragments with symbols or other text as you write, using configurable rules including regex patterns.
